value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym, for walkers to 3 year olds with a parent, in 45-minute slots like 9:30 and 4:30 from Sept 14 - their site says. Fall registration has been open since July 22 at 8am online. I could not pin down the day or the price, and they also run Tumble & Learn for 2y 11m to 4. I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
